law_name: Law No. 21.719 on the Protection and Processing of Personal Data
jurisdiction: Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales
key_requirements: Legal bases beyond consent (contract, legitimate interest); portability; breach notification; DPO/compliance model
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Agency (Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales)
penalties_range: Up to 20,000 UTM (~USD 1.3M) for very serious infringements
notes: Law 21.719 rewrites Ley 19.628, creates new agency; in force 2026-12-01
pending_change: Law 21.719 takes effect and replaces Law 19.628, which applies until then
